arguments.text: 8 km = 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer owns effort. My jobs: (1) weed/drag: speed drops at same pod power and same HR inside a leg -> clear_rudder, check the speed dip and recovery; (2) pod drift: pod power moves but HR and GPS speed do not -> set pod_gain; (3) radio course change -> set_race_distance + tell distance; (4) answer paddler talk (evidence, not fact); (5) judge true CP from HR trend (climbs above CP, flat below). Around min 4-8 record baselines: eta_est, HR vs pod power, push_local per direction.
